# Unit ADC v1.1 artwork

Two high-resolution PNGs are enabled by default and explicitly marked `reference-redraw`. The front image is the positive/negative color mark on the orange fixed terminal roof. The rear reproduces readable ADC V1.1 / 0-12V / PORT. A. I2C / ADS1110 and SCL / SDA / 5V / GND printing from this exact U013-V11 product's own official photographs. Source URLs, hashes and panel registration are in [artwork.json](./artwork.json).

Both are code-drawn at150px/mm; no product photograph pixels are cropped, projected, sampled or enlarged. Text and color registration remain appearance estimates. The original ADC and M5 embossed shell marks are native physical triangles and remain visible with `artwork:false`. Neither PNG closes a connector mouth or mounting bore.

Only final ordinary PNGs are distributed. Raw references, source artwork, generators and intermediates remain excluded. `new Model({artwork:false})` and `new GroveModule({artwork:false})` hide these two printed layers while preserving all physical attribute/index buffers and world transforms. Product names, printed designs and trademarks retain their respective rights.
